subject: A Tamil woman arranging a traditional kolam at the entrance of a Chettinad home, wearing an authentic Kanchipuram silk saree with a neatly draped pallu and traditional gold jewellery; natural, candid expression

setting.place: A traditional Chettinad courtyard house in the Sivaganga region of Tamil Nadu, with an open central courtyard, carved wooden doors, and Athangudi tile flooring
setting.era: Present day, preserving traditional Chettinad architecture and customs

lighting: Soft, natural early-morning light with gentle shadows; realistic skin tones and balanced exposure

camera.shot: Medium-wide environmental shot showing the woman, kolam, and courtyard
camera.angle: Eye-level, slightly diagonal view into the courtyard

style: Photorealistic documentary photography, respectful cultural detail, natural textures, believable proportions, no exaggerated postcard aesthetic
